rounds.ai_message: Good morning. Welcome to our factory. I am Mr. Chen, the factory director.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 早上好，欢迎来到我们工厂，我是厂长陈先生。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 自我介绍，说明来访目的
key_phrases: We are looking for a factory
rounds.common_mistakes: 自我介绍不要说 'My name is Lily, nice to meet'，要补全 nice to meet you。
rounds.tips_zh: 到厂拜访先报姓名、公司和目的，厂长一般带你先看产线。
rounds.user_response_example: Good morning, Mr. Chen. This is Lily from Paris Mode Trading. Nice to meet you. We are looking for a factory for our knit polo order.

rounds.ai_message: Nice to meet you too. Do you need CMT only, or full package with fabric?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 很高兴认识你。你们是只要 CMT 加工，还是连面料一起的包工包料？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 回答需要 CMT 还是全包
rounds.common_mistakes: CMT 不要说成 CTM；CMT = cut, make, trim。
rounds.tips_zh: CMT 指裁剪、缝制、整烫加工；full package 含面辅料采购。
rounds.user_response_example: We need CMT only. We will provide the fabric and trims from our nominated suppliers.

rounds.ai_message: Understood. We have 6 sewing lines, about 180 workers. Each line has 30 machines.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。我们有 6 条缝制线，大约 180 名工人，每条线 30 台机器。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 询问主要机器类型
rounds.common_mistakes: sewing line 是缝制产线，不是 'production line' 里随便说 line。
rounds.tips_zh: 针织 Polo 常用平缝机、包缝机和绷缝机，问机器即判断厂能做哪种工艺。
rounds.user_response_example: Good size. What machines do you have on each line? We need overlock and flatlock machines for the polo.

rounds.ai_message: Each line has 12 lockstitch, 12 overlock and 6 flatlock machines. What SPI do you need?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 每条线有 12 台平缝、12 台包缝、6 台绷缝机。你们线迹密度要求多少 SPI？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 回答 SPI 要求
rounds.common_mistakes: SPI 是 stitches per inch，不要说成 'needle per inch'。
rounds.tips_zh: 针织常用 SPI 10-12；梭织衬衫常见 SPI 12-14。
rounds.user_response_example: We need SPI 10 to 12 on the main seams, and SPI 8 is fine for the overlock edges. Details are in our tech pack.

rounds.ai_message: OK. For this polo, our IE team sets the SMV at 18 minutes. Daily output is about 800 pieces per line.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。这款 Polo 我们 IE 团队定的标准工时是 18 分钟，每条线日产能约 800 件。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认日产能是否满足订单
key_phrases: how many lines for my order
rounds.common_mistakes: daily output 不要说成 'day output'；SMV 直接念 S-M-V。
rounds.tips_zh: 日产能 = 每天工时 ÷ SMV × 人数 × 效率，先粗算再谈排产。
rounds.user_response_example: 800 pieces per day per line is good. Our order is 12,000 pieces, so two lines can finish the sewing in about a week.

rounds.ai_message: Right. Our CMT price for this polo is US$1.85 per piece. What is your target?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 没错。这款 Polo 的 CMT 加工费是每件 1.85 美元。你们的目标价是多少？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 回应报价并尝试议价
rounds.common_mistakes: 议价不要说 'Your price is expensive'；说 'Could you do US$1.60?' 更专业。
rounds.tips_zh: Polo 衫 CMT 常见 1.5-2.2 美元/件，量大可压 5-10%。
rounds.user_response_example: Our target is US$1.60 per piece. For 12,000 pieces, could you do that? We have repeat orders coming.

rounds.ai_message: For 12,000 pieces I can do US$1.70, but that is my best. Lead time is 30 days after PP sample approval.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 12,000 件我可以做到 1.70 美元，但这是我的最低价。大货前样批核后 30 天交期。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 接受价格，确认交期
rounds.common_mistakes: PP sample 是 pre-production sample，不要和 TOP sample 混淆。
rounds.tips_zh: CMT 交期从 PP 样批核起算，样衣确认越慢交期越紧。
rounds.user_response_example: US$1.70 is acceptable. 30 days after PP sample approval works for us. We will send the tech pack this week.

rounds.ai_message: Good. For packing, we use one piece per polybag, 24 pieces per carton. Is that OK?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。尾部包装是一件一胶袋，每箱 24 件。这样可以吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认包装方式，收尾
rounds.common_mistakes: polybag 不要说成 'plastic bag'；外箱唛头叫 shipping marks。
rounds.tips_zh: 纸箱尺寸、毛重和唛头要写进包装资料，避免到港后改箱。
rounds.user_response_example: Yes, one piece per polybag and 24 pieces per carton is fine. I will send you the shipping marks and carton size. Thank you, Mr. Chen.

rounds.ai_message: Hi Lily, thanks for coming. Our production manager and IE engineer will join the factory tour. Shall we start from the cutting room?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 嗨 Lily，谢谢来访。我们生产经理和 IE 工程师会一起陪同参观，先从裁剪车间开始？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 同意参观，并提出想看的重点
key_phrases: I would like to see the spreading
rounds.common_mistakes: 参观时不要说 'show me your factory' 太笼统；点名要看的工序更专业。
rounds.tips_zh: 跟单验厂重点看裁剪房铺布、排料利用率和产线平衡，而不只是车间干净与否。
rounds.user_response_example: Yes, let's start with the cutting room. I would like to check the spreading and your marker utilization, then walk through one sewing line.

rounds.ai_message: Sure. We spread 80 plies for this knit fabric and cut with a straight knife. Our marker utilization is around 88 percent.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。这款针织面料我们铺 80 层，用直刀裁剪，排料利用率约 88%。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 评价利用率，询问面料损耗控制
key_phrases: how do you control fabric waste
rounds.common_mistakes: marker utilization 是排料利用率，别说成 'cutting rate'。
rounds.tips_zh: 针织排料利用率 85-90% 属正常；铺布断头损耗 end loss 要控制在 2% 以内。
rounds.user_response_example: 88 percent is decent. How do you control the end loss during spreading? Our fabric allowance is only 3 percent, so waste control matters.

rounds.ai_message: We use an automatic spreading machine with end catchers, so end loss stays under 2 percent. Now, this is sewing line 3 running your style.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 我们用自动铺布机配夹布器，断头损耗控制在 2% 以内。现在这条 3 号线正在做你们这款。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 询问该产线效率与人数配置
rounds.common_mistakes: line efficiency 是产线效率；别说 'how fast is the line'。
rounds.tips_zh: 产线效率 = 产出分钟数 ÷（人数 × 出勤分钟）；65-75% 是行业中上水平。
rounds.user_response_example: Good. What is the current line efficiency, and how many operators are on this line? The WIP looks quite low, which is a good sign.

rounds.ai_message: This line has 28 operators and runs at about 72 percent efficiency. Based on the SMV of 18 minutes, we get around 750 pieces a day.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 这条线有 28 名车工，效率约 72%。按 18 分钟的标准工时，每天产出约 750 件。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 核算产能与订单交期匹配度
key_phrases: can you hit the ex-factory date
rounds.common_mistakes: 验算产能不要只问 'can you finish on time'；要用 SMV、效率、人数自己算。
rounds.tips_zh: 日产能 ≈ 人数 × 工作分钟 × 效率 ÷ SMV；28×480×72%÷18 ≈ 537，报 750 说明他们按加班或更高效率算的，值得追问。
rounds.user_response_example: Let me check the math — 28 operators at 72 percent efficiency on an SMV of 18 gives about 540 pieces in 8 hours. Are you counting overtime in the 750?

rounds.ai_message: Good catch. 750 includes one hour of overtime. Without overtime it is about 680 pieces. Your 12,000 pieces will take about 18 working days on one line.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 算得对。750 件含一小时加班，不加班约 680 件。你们 12,000 件一条线大约要 18 个工作日。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 提出排产方案，确认能否满足交期
rounds.common_mistakes: 排产要留返修 buffer，别把 30 天排满刚好卡交期。
rounds.tips_zh: 18 天缝制 + 裁剪 2 天 + 整烫包装 3 天，30 天交期可行但要紧盯前段。
rounds.user_response_example: To be safe, please run two lines in parallel for the first week. That gives us buffer for re-work before the ex-factory date on June 15th.

rounds.ai_message: We can do that. By the way, our QC found the collar shape curling after pressing on the first output. Can you approve a slightly higher fusing temperature?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 可以安排。另外，我们 QC 发现首批衣领整烫后有点卷边，你能同意粘合温度调高一点吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 回应整烫问题，要求先测试
key_phrases: test on a few pieces first
rounds.common_mistakes: 工艺变更不要当场口头同意；先测试再批。
rounds.tips_zh: 粘合温度过高会渗胶或面料变色，调温前先洗水测试并留样。
rounds.user_response_example: Collar curling after pressing is a defect risk. Please raise the fusing temperature on a few test pieces first, wash them, and send me photos before we approve it for bulk.

rounds.ai_message: Fair enough. Back to commercials: at US$1.70 per piece CMT, our margin is thin. Can you relax the AQL to 4.0 instead of 2.5?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 没问题。回到商务条款：CMT 每件 1.70 美元我们利润很薄，验货标准能从 AQL 2.5 放宽到 4.0 吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 拒绝放宽 AQL，守住质量底线
rounds.common_mistakes: AQL 是验货标准不是质量目标；说 'accept AQL 4.0' 等于公开放宽缺陷率。
rounds.tips_zh: 价格和 AQL 不要打包交换；质量底线不可谈，可以谈的是交期或付款。
rounds.user_response_example: AQL 2.5 is our company standard and not negotiable. If the price is tight, we can discuss the payment terms instead, but not the inspection level.

rounds.ai_message: Understood, AQL 2.5 it is. Then let us confirm: 12,000 pieces, CMT US$1.70, ex-factory June 15th, two lines first week. Anything else before we sign?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白，就按 AQL 2.5。那确认一下：12,000 件，CMT 每件 1.70 美元，6 月 15 日出厂，首周两条线。签约前还有什么？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 补充包装与文件要求，收尾
rounds.common_mistakes: 收尾只说 'OK let's sign' 不够；把包装、周报、唛头一次性说清。
rounds.tips_zh: 大货期间要求工厂发周报（裁剪数、车缝数、整烫数），进度失控可提前发现。
rounds.user_response_example: Yes, two things: please send a weekly production report covering cutting, sewing and packing quantities, and confirm the carton marks before mass packing. Then we are good to sign.

rounds.ai_message: Lily, I will be straight with you. Your order landed in our peak season, and we are running at 95 percent capacity. I can slot you in only if you accept a two-line setup instead of three.
rounds.ai_message_zh: Lily，我直说了，你们订单正赶上我们旺季，产能已经排到 95%。你们能接受两条线而不是三条线排产，我才能插单。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 质疑产能说法，要求看数据
key_phrases: why two lines instead of three
rounds.common_mistakes: 对方说产能紧张时别马上让步；要数据，别只听口头说法。
rounds.tips_zh: 旺季插单是工厂抬价常见话术；要求看线负荷表 line loading chart 验证真伪。
rounds.user_response_example: Before I accept that, show me your line loading chart for June. If you are truly at 95 percent, two lines with overtime can still hit our date — but I want the numbers, not just the narrative.

rounds.ai_message: Fair. The loading chart shows line 3 and 5 free from June 1st. But with your polo at SMV 18 and our 70 percent efficiency, two lines give you 1,300 pieces a day. That is 10 working days, cutting it close to your June 15th ex-factory.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 行。负荷表显示 3 号线和 5 号线 6 月 1 日空出。你们 Polo SMV 18、效率 70%，两条线日产 1,300 件，要 10 个工作日，离 6 月 15 出厂很紧。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 指出时间风险，提出压缩方案
rounds.common_mistakes: 裁剪提前启动要书面授权并自担风险，口头答应出问题是你的锅。
rounds.tips_zh: 大货裁剪原则上须等 PP 样批核；赶单时可书面授权 at buyer's risk 先行裁剪。
rounds.user_response_example: Ten days of sewing is tight but doable if we overlap the processes. I will authorize cutting to start before PP approval, at our risk, in writing — but sewing starts only after the PP sample is approved. No exceptions.

rounds.ai_message: Agreed. But honestly, your tech pack calls for SPI 14 on the topstitching. That is denim-level density on a knit polo — it slows the line by 15 percent and causes puckering. Can we compromise at SPI 12?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 同意。但说实话，你们工艺单要求明线 SPI 14，这是牛仔级的密度用在针织 Polo 上——会拖慢产线 15%，还起皱。能降到 SPI 12 吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 评估 SPI 让步，要求样衣验证
rounds.common_mistakes: SPI 不是越高越好；针织上过高密度会切断纱线、起皱。
rounds.tips_zh: 针织明线 SPI 10-12 足够；改参数前先车样布对比，批样后以封样为准。
rounds.user_response_example: You have a point — SPI 14 on knit topstitching can pucker. Sew a mock-up at SPI 12 and SPI 13, send photos and physical samples, and we will approve whichever passes our wash test. The approved sample governs.

rounds.ai_message: Will do. Next issue: our first bulk output failed the pressing check — 8 percent of the pieces have shine marks on the placket. My pressing team says your polyester-blend piqué cannot take high heat. Thoughts?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。下一个问题：首批大货整烫检验没过，8% 的件门襟有极光。整烫组说你们的涤棉珠地不耐高温。你怎么看？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 给出整烫解决方案，明确返工责任
rounds.common_mistakes: 整烫极光是工厂工艺问题，别答应平摊返工费。
rounds.tips_zh: 涤纶面料整烫要用低温加蒸汽、垫布压烫；极光 shine mark 属工厂操作缺陷，返工费由工厂承担。
rounds.user_response_example: Shine marks mean the iron temperature is too high or they pressed without a cloth. Lower the temperature, use steam with a pressing cloth, and the 8 percent gets re-worked at your cost — that is a workmanship issue, not a fabric issue.

rounds.ai_message: I accept the re-work cost, but let us be fair — your fabric spec sheet says nothing about pressing temperature. Add a care instruction to the tech pack and we split the re-work fifty-fifty.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 返工费我认，但讲道理——你们面料规格表没写整烫温度。工艺单补上护理说明，返工费我们五五分。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 拒绝分摊，坚持责任归属
key_phrases: we will not split re-work cost
rounds.common_mistakes: 对方用 'let's be fair' 施压时别软；责任在操作方，不在规格表。
rounds.tips_zh: 工艺单没写整烫温度不构成买方责任——工厂作为 CMT 加工方有基本工艺判断义务。
rounds.user_response_example: The spec sheet gap is fair feedback and we will add a care instruction. But pressing within safe temperature is basic CMT workmanship — your team should have flagged it on the PP sample, not after 8 percent of bulk. We will not split the re-work cost.

rounds.ai_message: Alright, we absorb it. Now packing: your packing instruction says 24 pieces per carton, but our carton supplier can only deliver 25 kg-rated cartons, and 24 polos with hangers exceed that. Options?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好吧，我们承担。现在说包装：你们指示每箱 24 件，但我们纸箱供应商只能提供 25 公斤承重纸箱，24 件带衣架超重了。怎么办？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在改箱规和减件数之间选择
rounds.common_mistakes: 箱规一改，装柜数量、运费全变；别只回 'you decide'。
rounds.tips_zh: 改箱规要同步更新装箱单和订舱数据；双瓦楞纸箱成本每件约加 0.02-0.03 美元。
rounds.user_response_example: Two options: upgrade to double-wall cartons and keep 24 pieces, or drop to 20 pieces per carton. Cost them both, but keep gross weight per carton under 25 kg — that is a hard limit from our forwarder.

rounds.ai_message: Double-wall cartons it is, at US$0.03 extra per piece. One more ask: with the re-work and the carton upgrade, our margin is gone. Can you release a 10 percent balance before PSI instead of after?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 那就双瓦楞纸箱，每件加 0.03 美元。再提一个请求：返工加纸箱升级后我们没利润了，尾款能否在验货前先放 10%？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 拒绝验货前放尾款，给替代方案
key_phrases: we can release the deposit faster next order
rounds.common_mistakes: 验货前放尾款 = 放弃最后筹码；永远别在 PSI 前放超过定金比例的钱。
rounds.tips_zh: 尾款节奏是买方核心杠杆；可谈的是下单一号位排产或更快的定金节奏，不是本单尾款。
rounds.user_response_example: The balance stays after PSI — that is our payment term and it stands. What I can offer is priority line booking and a faster deposit on the next order. The re-work cost was yours by your own admission; it does not become a payment-term discussion.

rounds.ai_message: You drive a hard bargain, Lily. Fine — double-wall cartons, 24 pieces, balance after PSI, ex-factory June 15th with two lines from June 1st, SPI per approved mock-up, re-work on us. I will send the revised PI today.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 你真不好对付，Lily。行——双瓦楞纸箱、每箱 24 件、验货后付尾款、6 月 1 日两条线上线、6 月 15 日出厂、SPI 按批核样布、返工我们承担。修订版 PI 今天发你。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认全部条款，约定验货时间
rounds.common_mistakes: 收尾要逐项复述确认，别只回 'OK thanks'；口误项当场纠正。
rounds.tips_zh: PSI 至少提前 5 个工作日预约第三方；PI 修订版收到后逐项核对再回签。
rounds.user_response_example: Confirmed on all points. Please put the carton upgrade and the re-work clause in writing on the revised PI. I will book the third-party PSI for June 12th, and the weekly production report starts this Friday. Pleasure doing business with you, Mr. Chen.
